ops.text: Premise partially FALSIFIED: cc-transcript 14.7/rable is exonerated — Word.value/raw byte-identical across 14.6.1/14.7.0 for every failing token. Fault is captain-hook b65dfe88: (D1, 5/8 tests) Call.sub emits [emit_raw(t.raw)] (cmd.py:340), dropping the old emit_token(token, plain_words=...) emission-safety gate (util/shell.py:31) that refused operands carrying * ? [ ~ {} $ backtick or quoted backslash — occurrence.embeddable() only checks quote-layer survival, not metacharacter safety, so trash $FOO / trash '*.txt' / trash /outside/{a,b} splice and ALLOW. (D2, 1) backslash-newline foo\<newline>bar parses to two words on BOTH versions — non-round-tripping rewrite, pre-existing day-one gap, needs an occurrence-source round-trip check; emit_token fix will NOT close it. (D3, 1) rm $FOO under scratch now denies where old allowed — fail-closed over-block, arguably MORE correct; recommend updating the test to expect deny. (D4, 1) stale monkeypatch: deletions no longer has glob/glob_matches (moved to util.globbing) — test-only. LATENT (no test): Target.has_glob uses glob.has_magic on the DEQUOTED value, so quoted '*.nomatch' with no fs match → empty expansion → allow for a literal outside any repo (confirmed live); needs quote-aware has_glob. Blast isolated to the rm rewrite path (.sub used nowhere else; fixes-pack DangerousCommand is block-only). Fix branch fix-deletions-import@c152fbc6 (rable wave) greens 86/86 — adversarial verification against this D1-D4+latent checklist in flight.
